headline:
Earnings beat sparks
8.7% jump, PEG still low
chart_note: 10-day range: $208.48 - $227.98. Jumped 8.7% on Aug 27 after Q2 earnings, more than reversing a mid-month pullback.
why_today: Closed up 8.7% on Aug 27 after beating Q2 estimates - revenue up 85% YoY, EPS up over 200% - now trading right back near its 52-week high.
pro_1: Revenue and earnings both growing at extraordinary rates YoY (+85% / +214%), with a 63% profit margin
pro_2: PEG ratio of 0.59 suggests the stock isn't expensive relative to its growth rate, despite a 33x trailing P/E
con_1: Up nearly 20% in the past month alone, most of it in a single earnings-day jump - a lot of good news is now priced in
con_2: High beta (2.2) means big swings both ways - and shares are back within a few percent of their 52-week high
